lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ek simar ek simar ek simar piaare ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales lobh moh mahaa bhaujal taare || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas nimakh nimakh dinas rain chitaare ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g man nidhaan dhaare ||1||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, and enshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal namasakaar gun gobid beechaare ||
lines.translation: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadh janaa kee ren naanak ma(n)gal sookh sadhaare ||2||1||31||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace. ||2||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 8 dupade ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarau simar simar sukh paavau saas saas samaale ||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਰਲੋਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ih lok paralok sa(n)g sahaaee jat kat mohi rakhavaale ||1||
lines.translation: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support; wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa bachan basai jee naale ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal nahee doobai tasakar nahee levai bhaahi na saakai jaale ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਟਿਕ ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niradhan kau dhan a(n)dhule kau tik maat doodh jaise baale ||
lines.translation: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: saagar mahi bohith paaio har naanak karee kripaa kirapaale ||2||1||32||
lines.translation: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord has bestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gobi(n)daa a(n)mrit ridai si(n)chaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectar permeates my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidh ridh sidh har laag rahee jan paaee ||1||
lines.translation: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling to the feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kau anad sagal hee jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihi baahar thaakur bhagatan kaa rav rahiaa srab thaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau koi na pahuchanahaaraa jaa kai a(n)g gusaaee ||
lines.translation: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: jam kee traas mitai jis simarat naanak naam dhiaaee ||2||2||33||
lines.translation: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: darabava(n)t darab dekh garabai bhoomava(n)t abhimaanee ||
lines.translation: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pride in his lands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਟੇਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa jaanai sagal raaj hamaraa tiu har jan tek suaamee ||1||
lines.translation: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, the humble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਓਟ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je kooo apunee ot samaarai ||
lines.translation: When one considers the Lord to be his only support,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਿਤੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa bit taisaa hoi varatai apunaa bal nahee haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਆਸਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan tiaag bhae ik aasar saran saran kar aae ||
lines.translation: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, "Save me, save me!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t anugrah bhae man niramal naanak har gun gaae ||2||3||34||
lines.translation: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau har ra(n)g laago is jug mahi so kaheeat hai sooraa ||
lines.translation: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aatam jinai sagal vas taa kai jaa kaa satigur pooraa ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1||
